obligations.behavior: ImplementationLedgerRecord gains an optional commit_hash field. ParseImplementationLedgerJSONL accepts (does not require) commit_hash on implementation_completed, fallback_completion, and partial_implementation_recorded records. The validator rejects commit_hash values that are not 40-char lowercase hex.

ValidatePerAtomCoverage takes per-atom commit hashes and changed_paths, queries git log --name-only for each commit hash, and produces a ledger_under_reports_path finding for any git path not in that atom's changed_paths. This prevents piggybacking: atom B cannot rely on atom A's changed_paths to cover a shared file.

ValidatePerAtomCoverage returns findings for atoms with commit_hash set but no git output (missing/invalid commit), atoms with empty changed_paths despite having a valid commit, and atoms whose changed_paths omits a path present in their commit diff. It does not flag atoms without commit_hash (backward compatible).

product lint --effort-root calls ValidatePerAtomCoverage for atoms with commit_hash set, in addition to the existing ValidateLedgerCoverage union check. Lint fails if any atom's commit changed paths that its ledger changed_paths does not record. Lint continues to pass for atoms without commit_hash (backward compatible).
The atom does not add git, os, exec, or flag imports to scope.go. Pure validation logic stays in scope.go; git command execution stays in cmd/idiom/product_workflow.go.
